Project guide Phase 1 Assessment

Phase 1 · Approval gate

Frame the Mandate

Agree on the world you are investing in and the rules you cannot break.

Decision question

What must be true about markets and each client before we are willing to invest?

Establish one defensible 12-month market view and convert each assigned client profile into an approved investment mandate.

Committee motion

Motion to approve the committee's market view and the investment mandate for each assigned client.

Workstreams

Market view

Read the historical data before using AI, compare the committee view with FactSet/FRED consensus, and build bull/base/bear scenarios.

Client mandate

Translate each client profile into RRTTLLU constraints, return targets, liquidity needs, and an explicit drawdown tripwire.

Conflict register

Surface tensions among return, risk, liquidity, taxes, legal restrictions, and unique circumstances before approving the mandate.

Required evidence

  • Human-first five-year macro read with source dates
  • FactSet/FRED consensus comparison and team forecast
  • Bull/base/bear scenarios with probabilities totaling 100%
  • RRTTLLU analysis for all three assigned clients
  • Return target, maximum volatility, and drawdown tripwire for each client
  • Phase 1 decision record signed by all four members

Committee responsibilities

Committee seatResponsibility in Phase 1
Committee Chair & Client Mandate LeadLead the RRTTLLU review, resolve client constraint conflicts, and frame the approval motion.
Markets & Economic StrategistBuild the human-first macro read, compare it with consensus, and propose base and bear scenarios.
Portfolio Construction LeadIdentify the portfolio decisions that the approved market view and client mandates must support.
Risk, Controls & Challenge LeadChallenge scenario assumptions, verify sources, and define the evidence required at the first gate.

Approval standard

Gate 1

Approve or revise the common market view and all three client mandates. Portfolio construction cannot begin until the vote and action items are recorded.

The decision record must state the motion, evidence reviewed, each member's vote, any dissent or reservation, and the owner and due date for every required revision.

Phase 1

Resources

XLSX Macro starter workbook Historical data, human-first analysis, consensus comparison, scenarios, and sensitivity modeling. PPTX Assigned client profiles Five team sets with three client mandates per team. XLSX Client scenario data Structured profile data, targets, volatility limits, and risk classifications. DOCX IPS client-analysis framework Blank framework for objectives, RRTTLLU constraints, allocation, monitoring, and acknowledgment. XLSX Committee decision record Role charter, gate-by-gate evidence review, motions, client-level votes, dissent, action items, and AI audit log.

Deliverables

  • Completed macro starter workbook
  • Three completed client IPS documents
  • One-page committee mandate memo
  • Phase 1 decision record
